escalation: 3% annual increase on each anniversary of commencement date
cam: Tenant pays 12% proportional share of total CAM expenses, payable within 15 days of invoice
renewal_option: Two successive options: first option for 5 years, second option for 3 years (contingent on exercising first option). 120 days written notice required prior to expiration of then-current term. Tenant must not be in default.
key_provisions: Renewal options contingent on tenant not being in default
CAM expenses invoiced separately from base rent
